must_detect.path_substring: urlref: description/when_to_use names no file extension, filename, backticked literal, hyphenated identifier, or mid-sentence proper noun, and states no trigger sentence either

expected_behavior: regression for the bare-TLD/URL-host bug: a URL host like 'example.org' used to be extracted as BOTH an owned dotted-filename token ('example.org') and a bare extension token ('.org'), letting any description that merely mentions a URL manufacture >=1 'unique' anchor token for free and never trip NO-UNIQUE-ANCHOR

skills/urlref's description ('Handles reminders and syncs data with example.org for the team.') has no genuine anchor-grade content once the URL host is correctly excluded — 'Handles' is a sentence-initial generic verb (ends in -s, filtered) and 'example.org' must not be counted
validate-skills.sh must emit the real [NO-UNIQUE-ANCHOR] (structurally un-anchorable / never tried) verdict, not be masked into silence by the URL-derived token
